PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

3. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

5. When learning Free-hand sketching, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Free-hand sketching.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Free-hand sketching.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Free-hand sketching.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Free-hand sketching.

6. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.

7. When learning Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

8. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials.

11. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.

12. When learning Introduction to Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Measuring and Marking Out Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Introduction to Entrepreneurship 8  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Hardware and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Entrepreneurship 8 5.2 Production Unit 10 5.3 Financial Goals 10 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
